segment.source: Alright... last topic, of course, earthquake repairs.<end>
segment.target: Alright... last topic, of course, earthquake repairs.<end>

segment.source: What's the situation at the South Tunnel?<end>
segment.target: What's the situation at the South Tunnel?<end>

segment.source: Got to dig deeper to plant the explosives, or we risk more damage to the tunnel.<end>
segment.target: Got to dig deeper to plant the explosives, or we risk more damage to the tunnel.<end>

segment.source: Almost everyone is working shifts up there. Shouldn't be too long now.<end>
segment.target: Almost everyone is working shifts up there. Shouldn't be too long now.<end>

segment.source: ::He nods.:: Gorsky, how's the security looking?<end>
segment.target: ::He nods.:: Gorsky, how's the security looking?<end>

segment.source: Got one man at the cave exit and that's enough, as far as I'm concerned. Automated security is strong there and as long as we know the Crossroad and the Cove are clear, no one can sneak up on us.<end>
segment.target: Got one man at the cave exit and that's enough, as far as I'm concerned. Automated security is strong there and as long as we know the Crossroad and the Cove are clear, no one can sneak up on us.<end>

segment.source: Also, got one man at the under-passages, and he's been ordered not to open the gate no matter what. The last thing we need right now are those bloody Lurkers sneaking up on us.<end>
segment.target: Also, got one man at the under-passages, and he's been ordered not to open the gate no matter what. The last thing we need right now are those bloody Lurkers sneaking up on us.<end>

segment.source: Everyone else is up at the platform securing workers and tunnels.<end>
segment.target: Everyone else is up at the platform securing workers and tunnels.<end>

segment.source: Good, good. If no one has anything else to add, that will conclude this council meeting...<end>
segment.target: Good, good. If no one has anything else to add, that will conclude this council meeting...<end>

segment.source: Actually... just one more thing, in case you weren't informed already: I admitted a new citizen to the station. <end>
segment.target: Actually... just one more thing, in case you weren't informed already: I admitted a new citizen to the station. <end>

segment.source: Yes. I think $(#he/she) will be a good addition to this station. $(#He/She) and Vencel are still at the range, but they should be done any moment now, I believe.<end>
segment.target: Yes. I think $(#he/she) will be a good addition to this station. $(#He/She) and Vencel are still at the range, but they should be done any moment now, I believe.<end>

segment.source: You put too much trust in your tests, Tanner. All I care about is how $(#he/she) handles live action, not how many points $(#he/she) got.<end>
segment.target: You put too much trust in your tests, Tanner. All I care about is how $(#he/she) handles live action, not how many points $(#he/she) got.<end>

segment.source: Well, we'll find out soon enough. Best put $(#him/her) to work immediately. We need all hands on deck right now.<end>

segment.source: Indeed. That is all. Vera. Gorsky.<end>
